PS3 Color Icon Pack (White)

Source page:
http://www.ps3-themes.com/misc/color-icon-pack-9-themes.html

Theme file:
http://download.ps3-themes.com/downloads/2848-WHITE.p3t

Theme author credited by the source page: RIDER121
Published: September 12, 2008

The source page describes these as original PS3 icons at their original shapes and sizes, recolored white for firmware 2.40+.

Assets were extracted from the P3T's zlib-compressed GIM payloads and converted to transparent PNG without redrawing the silhouettes.

This directory contains only the subset used by the portfolio interface.
